# 404lab

> Fifty-six animated not-found pages for Next.js (App Router), Motion, and Tailwind CSS v4. Installed via shadcn, MCP, or agent skills, owned by you.

## Key Links

- Catalogue: https://404lab.dev
- Registry Template: https://404lab.dev/r/{name}.json
- Registry Index: https://404lab.dev/r/registry.json
- Agent Skill (SKILL.md): https://404lab.dev/skills/404lab/SKILL.md
- Source Repository: https://github.com/Anos714/404labs

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @404lab/glitch-404
```

Or without configuring `components.json`:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://404lab.dev/r/glitch-404.json
```

## Categories

- `scene` (17): Atmospheric scenes and spatial metaphors (`/p/mosaic-404`, `/p/spotlight-404`, `/p/flood-404`, `/p/fog-404`, `/p/terminal-404`, ...)
- `type` (16): Kinetic typography and numeral studies (`/p/glitch-404`, `/p/odometer-404`, `/p/morse-404`, `/p/ticker-404`, `/p/sweep-404`, ...)
- `interactive` (23): Pointer, keyboard, and physics-driven pages (`/p/brick-404`, `/p/snake-404`, `/p/gravity-404`, `/p/magnet-404`, `/p/dial-404`, ...)

## AI Agent Integration

- **Agent Skill**: Install `https://404lab.dev/skills/404lab/SKILL.md` into `.agents/skills/404lab/SKILL.md`.
- **MCP Server**: `node mcp/server.mjs` exposes `list_pages`, `search_pages`, `get_page`, `get_shared_file`, `get_install_guide`, `get_agent_skill`, and resources `lab404://library`, `lab404://pages/{slug}`, `lab404://skill`.
